components.label: ZTF Object API
components.description: Queries metadata for ZTF alert objects (name, coordinates, first/last detection).

components.label: ZTF Lightcurve API
components.description: Returns detections and non-detections (the photometric light curve) for a ZTF object.

components.label: ZTF Magstats API
components.description: Per-band magnitude statistics (min, max, mean) for a ZTF object.

components.label: ZTF Probabilities API
components.description: Classifier probabilities (e.g. SN, AGN, variable star) for a ZTF object.

components.label: ZTF Features API
components.description: Light-curve features used as input to ALeRCE classifiers.

components.label: ZTF Classifiers API
components.description: Lists the available ZTF classifiers and their output classes.

components.label: ZTF Forced Photometry API
components.description: Forced-photometry light curves (flux measured at a fixed position) for ZTF objects.

components.label: ZTF Lightcurve API (v2)
components.description: Combined light curve (detections, non-detections, forced photometry) from the v2 lightcurve service used by the object page.

components.label: ZTF Object List / Ranking
components.description: Paginated object search with classifier ranking — the query behind the Explorer results page.

components.label: ZTF Data Release Lightcurve
components.description: ZTF data-release photometry cone-search (the external-sources feature on the light curve).

components.label: ZTF Stamps API
components.description: Image stamps (science, reference, difference) for ZTF alerts.

components.label: Crossmatch backend (catshtm)
components.description: Direct all-catalog cone-search against the catshtm backend (Gaia, AllWISE, etc.) — the service behind the object-page crossmatch. Position-dependent latency, so it carries its own latency limits.

components.label: ZTF Object Page — Info
components.description: Object metadata panel (HTMX) rendered on the ZTF object page.

components.label: ZTF Object Page — Lightcurve
components.description: Light-curve widget (HTMX) rendered on the ZTF object page. Heavy for high-detection objects, so it carries its own latency limits.

components.label: ZTF Object Page — Magstats
components.description: Per-band magnitude statistics (HTMX) rendered on the ZTF object page.

components.label: ZTF Object Page — Probabilities
components.description: Classifier probabilities (HTMX) rendered on the ZTF object page.

components.label: ZTF Object Page — Crossmatch
components.description: External-catalog crossmatch (HTMX) rendered on the ZTF object page — the user-facing path in front of the catshtm backend. Position-dependent latency, so it carries its own limits.

components.label: ZTF Object Page — TNS
components.description: Transient Name Server lookup (HTMX) rendered on the ZTF object page.

components.label: Object Info
components.description: Object metadata panel (HTMX) for multi-survey / LSST objects.

components.label: Object List (unfiltered)
components.description: Unfiltered paginated object search (HTMX) — what the multi-survey results table loads for a search with no filters set. The heaviest LSST query, so it carries its own latency limits.

components.label: SN Candidates (night)
components.description: Object search filtered by classifier, class and MJD night (HTMX) — the supernova-candidates-per-night query behind the LSST SN hunter. Filtered, so much faster than the unfiltered search.

components.label: Object Sidebar
components.description: Object navigation sidebar (HTMX) — the neighbouring-objects list loaded when stepping between objects within a filtered result set.

components.label: Lightcurve
components.description: Light-curve widget (HTMX) for multi-survey / LSST objects.

components.label: Magstats
components.description: Per-band magnitude statistics (HTMX) for multi-survey / LSST objects.

components.label: Probabilities
components.description: Classifier probabilities (HTMX) for multi-survey / LSST objects.

components.label: Stamps
components.description: Image stamps card (HTMX) for multi-survey / LSST objects.

components.label: Crossmatch
components.description: External-catalog crossmatch (HTMX) for multi-survey / LSST objects. Depends on the slow catshtm service, so it carries its own latency limits.

components.label: ALeRCE Explorer
components.description: Web interface for searching, visualizing, and inspecting ALeRCE alert objects.

components.label: Python Client Docs
components.description: Documentation for the alerce-client Python library on Read the Docs.
